R4.existence: kappa congruent to 7 modulo 24 and kappa at least 31
R4.provenance: k_perp=1 implies q divides h; q is not 3, hence q divides u and is eligible for the complete composite root-capacity menu; this is not raw E1

R6_m_mod_3_equals_1.existence: k>1 and 3 does not divide k
R6_m_mod_3_equals_1.provenance: k_perp=1 implies q divides u and menu eligibility, not raw E1

R6_m_mod_3_equals_0_k_gt_3.provenance: k_perp=1 implies q divides u and menu eligibility, not raw E1

R6_k_equals_3.definition: whole root-height modulus u=h/3; enumerate every 1<Q dividing u
R6_k_equals_3.existence: the k=3 primitive system gives u=A^2-A*B+B^2>1 and 3 does not divide u
R6_k_equals_3.forbidden_relabel: 3 does not divide u, but the absence of a nonthree factor from k does not make the Q|u menu empty

transverse.definition: all factors of verified D_star; a physical rule may select only the least independently verified fresh raw occurrence
transverse.provenance: D_star divides actual maximal-receipt D, yielding source-bound arithmetic factors but not consumable integer raw occurrences; a least arithmetic factor can be capacity-saturated
